justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeWriter.java` at the nested class definitions and factory methods. The target `WithActiveRecord` is only instantiated twice, both from private helper methods in the same file (`withDrain(...)` at lines 4570-4573 and `withoutDrain(...)` at lines 4593-4596), and `rg` found no other repository references beyond the two nested class declarations and those two call sites. Its dependencies are also local and limited to a few collaborators (`MethodVisitor`, `TypeDescription`, `MethodPool.Record`, `AnnotationValueFilter.Factory`, `Label`, `Implementation.Context`, `ByteCodeAppender.Size`), so there is no evidence of the high fan-in/fan-out expected for hub-like modularization.
